item.title: Beetroot sashimi
item.description: This sashimi is made from beetroot. It has an incredibly long shelf life, a texture that is really meaty and chewy, and it tastes amazing. I use it in multiple setups: Of course as an addition or replacement for fish in sashimi or sushi. It has a similar texture to raw tuna and is therefore a perfect match for your next vegan sushi party. As carpaccio or tartare, it works perfectly as a replacement for beef.
